title: Cornerstone
subtitle: Agentic construction management. Client sprint live: intake sent, engine week in flight.

items.what: Fund the Anthropic API wallet (~$200 to start)
items.how: Customer workloads run on metered API, never on a subscription. This powers certificate reading and reply handling.
items.label: console.anthropic.com → Billing

items.what: Create a dedicated Supabase project on Pro ($25/mo), name it cornerstone-prod
items.how: Customer data never shares a database with anything else. Pick us-east-1. Then send me the project URL + service-role key (Settings → API).
items.label: supabase.com → New project

items.what: Netcup VPS 1000 G12, Manassas USA, HOURLY billing (€0.017/hr, no commitment)
items.how: 4 vCPU / 8GB / 256GB. Ubuntu 24.04. Send me the IP + root password and I do everything else.
items.label: netcup.com → VPS 1000 G12

items.how: Intake notifications land at makeourcitypretty@gmail.com (sarah@ is a suppressed recipient in Resend; it sends FROM sarah@ fine).

groups.name: 2 · The Phone (SMS Can Lag Launch, Email Goes First)

items.what: Find or get the EIN (free, ~10 min)
items.how: Check email for the IRS CP-575 PDF or your business bank docs. Nothing? Apply online, issued instantly. Or call the IRS business line 800-829-4933 for a 147-C letter.
items.label: irs.gov → Get an EIN

items.what: Twilio: read the Trust Hub rejection reason, then resubmit the brand with the EXACT IRS legal name
items.how: Use case wording matters: transactional notifications to known business contacts under existing contracts, with opt-out. Not marketing.
items.label: console.twilio.com → Trust Hub

items.what: Flip the SMS adapter on the day A2P clears
items.how: Already stubbed in the engine. Zero code waiting on it at launch.
One link, ~20 minutes for them. It tells them exactly what to email afterward (COIs, W-9s, requirements, drawings).
items.label: cornerstone …/start

items.what: They email their documents to sarah@modernmustardseed.com
Quote them the real price. No pilot, no trial
items.how: Setup ($1,500 res / $5,000 comm) + first month at the tier ($449+ res / $1,200+ comm). Cancel monthly. Week one is supervised, which IS the safety story, not a discount excuse.

groups.name: 4 · Launch Week (Claude Builds, You Approve)
groups.note: Each step fires the moment its inputs above exist.

items.what: Apply the schema, load their job, ingest roster + COI PDFs, run adequacy checks
Reply ingest live (their subs' emails + attached certs file themselves)
Engine on the VPS: nightly sweep 23:40, report 04:45, guards armed, DRY_RUN off / shadow ON
Their console view live (their job, their subs, their chases, their report)
Shadow week: approve each drafted chase in one tap; call the client before the first live send
items.how: Your client-facing-send law, applied to their subs. Autonomy dials up per chase type as it proves out.

items.what: Say GO. The Marshal runs the ladder unsupervised, escalations still come to a human
items.how: The launch crew at go-live: Foreman (report) + Marshal (documents) + Scheduler (weather watch) + Logger (drop inbox).
